responsibility: Implements SARIF generation as a structured diagnostics sink. This file owns the construction of SARIF logs, runs, tool metadata, locations, logical locations, messages, code flows, graphs, fixes, artifacts, and property bags; it serializes diagnostics, paths, metadata, diagrams, and optional state graphs into SARIF JSON via a dedicated builder and serialization format layer, making it GCC’s machine-readable diagnostics backend rather than a text-oriented formatter.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation side of the SARIF sink pair: it builds and serializes SARIF logs/results/graphs and contains the concrete sink logic and tests, whereas sarif-sink.h declares the public sink factories, generation/serialization options, and SARIF object wrapper types.
